newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: U.S. envoy arrives in Botswana for talks on Zaire.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy arrives in Botswana for talks on Zaire.

text.p: U.S. envoy Bill Richardson arrived in the Botswana border town of Kasane on Tuesday for talks with Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni attending a business conference there.
Kasane airport officials said Richardson, U.S. ambassador to the United Nations and President Bill Clinton's envoy, arrived in a U.S. military plane.

South African President Nelson Mandela is also due in Kasane later on Tuesday morning to join the heads of state from Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Botswana and Namibia for the last day of the conference, and is expected to join the talks.
Uganda is one of the key supporters of the Tutsi-dominated rebels led by Laurent Kabila, who said earlier on Monday his forces were ready to enter Kinshasa in two or three days.
Richardson is trying to ensure a bloodless takeover of Kinshasa.

Troops from the United States, the former colonial power Belgium, France and Britain are waiting in Congo, across the river from Kinshasa, to evacuate Western nationals from the teeming capital of five million in the event of trouble.
